FN-JPLCCNF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 337
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 337 as introduced could increase the receipts to certain boards of education by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of proceeds received from the sale of certain
16th section and indemnity land owned by the local boards of education. This bill will not
otherwise not directly affect state or local funding.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 337
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: «Released Date»
Senate Bill 337 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the Franklin County Boards of
Education by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of proceeds received from the
sale of certain 16th section and indemnity land owned by the board. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
